name: Incident Reports (live IRS, minimal)
description: Bisect variant: same query as the live IRS summary, with the row-level policy, filters and filter datasets stripped out.

dataset.name: Incident report summary
dataset.query: SELECT r.id, r.report_reference, ctf.code AS type, ctf.description AS type_description, r.status, cs.description AS status_description, r.incident_date_and_time, r.incident_date_and_time AS incident_time, r.reported_at, r.reported_by, r.modified_at, regexp_replace(lower(sm.first_name || ' ' || sm.last_name), '(^|[^a-z])([a-z])', x -> x[1] || upper(x[2])) AS reported_by_name, r.title, r.description, r.location, p.name AS location_name, al.noms_region_code AS region_code, area.description AS region_name, pv.prisoners_involved FROM (SELECT id, report_reference, type, status, incident_date_and_time, reported_at, reported_by, modified_at, title, description, location FROM AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_report WHERE created_at < current_timestamp - interval '7' day UNION ALL SELECT id, report_reference, type, status, incident_date_and_time, reported_at, reported_by, modified_at, title, description, location FROM dps_inc_reporting.public.report WHERE created_at >= current_timestamp - interval '7' day) r JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_constant_status cs ON r.status = cs.code JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_constant_type ct ON r.type = ct.code JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_constant_type_family ctf ON ctf.code = ct.family_code JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.prisonregister_prison p ON p.prison_id = r.location JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.nomis_agency_locations al ON al.agy_loc_id = p.prison_id LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.nomis_staff_user_accounts sua ON sua.username = r.reported_by LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.nomis_staff_members sm ON sm.staff_id = sua.staff_id LEFT JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.nomis_areas area ON area.area_class = 'REGION' AND area.area_code = al.noms_region_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT pi.report_id, array_join(array_agg(pi.prisoner_number || ' ' || regexp_replace(lower(pi.last_name), '(^|[^a-z])([a-z])', x -> x[1] || upper(x[2])) || ', ' || regexp_replace(lower(pi.first_name), '(^|[^a-z])([a-z])', x -> x[1] || upper(x[2])) || ' (' || cr.description || ')' ORDER BY pi.prisoner_number ASC), ', ') AS prisoners_involved FROM (SELECT report_id, prisoner_number, prisoner_role, first_name, last_name FROM AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_prisoner_involvement UNION ALL SELECT pi.report_id, pi.prisoner_number, pi.prisoner_role, pi.first_name, pi.last_name FROM dps_inc_reporting.public.prisoner_involvement pi WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_prisoner_involvement d WHERE d.report_id = pi.report_id)) pi JOIN AwsDataCatalog.prisons.incidentreporting_constant_prisoner_role cr ON pi.prisoner_role = cr.code GROUP BY pi.report_id) pv ON pv.report_id = r.id WHERE r.status NOT IN ('DUPLICATE', 'NOT_REPORTABLE', 'DRAFT')

report.name: Incident report summary (live IRS, minimal)
report.description: Bisect variant. No filters, no row-level policy.
